get.description:
Returns item pockets hierarchical structure: pockets -> categories -> items (id, identifier, name, short_effect).
Eagerly loads relationships via selectinload/joinedload to bound SQL query count.

schema.title: Response Get Item Pockets Api Items Pockets Get

get.description:
Returns effect prose and short effect for a specific item.
Returns 404 if the item does not exist.

Returns berry statistics and potency per flavor.
Supports limit and offset with joined loads (zero N+1 queries).

schema.title: Response Get Berries Api Berries Get
Response Get Abilities Api Abilities Get
Response Get Items Api Items Get

get.description:
Retrieves and aggregates wild encounters for a Pokémon, grouped by Location and Location Area.
Uses column-select joins (no ORM hydration) and batch condition loading (zero N+1 queries).
Preserves NULL chance for gift/static encounters.

schema.title: Response Get Pokemon Encounters Api Pokemon  Id  Encounters Get

get.description:
Returns the complete evolution graph (nodes and edges) for a Pokémon's species.
Resolves all requirements and related names in a single query set (zero N+1 queries).
Single-stage species return an empty edge list with the one node.

Returns a paginated list of locations with optional filters for region and name.
Uses joinedload for Region to ensure bounded, single-query execution.

Returns a location with its areas and, for each area, a count of distinct Pokemon encountered.
Resolves area counts in a single aggregation query (no per-area N+1 queries).
Returns all regions ordered by id.

schema.title: Response Get Regions Api Regions Get

get.description: Returns all versions ordered by version group order then version id.

schema.title: Response Get Versions Api Versions Get

Cached in memory for 60 seconds.
